basic_details.job_title: CSL Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL), a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, is filling 2 supervisory posts at CSL Kolkata Ship Repair Unit (CKSRU), Kolkata. The posts are one Assistant Engineer (Civil) and one Assistant Engineer (Mechanical), both in grade PS1 with the pay scale ₹ 28,000-3%-1,10,000. Applicants need a three-year Diploma in Civil or Mechanical Engineering and seven years of post-qualification experience, and must be within 45 years of age as on 27 November 2026. Indian citizens can apply online only, through www.cochinshipyard.in (Career

age_limit.details: For both posts, the upper age limit shall not exceed 45 years as on 27 November 2026. This means applicants should be born on or after 28 November 1981. Age relaxation for Ex-servicemen is as per Government of India guidelines, up to 50 years. | Ex-servicemen must submit their Discharge Certificate/ Book/ Pension Payment Order from the Armed Forces. With the online application, they must also submit an undertaking (as per Annexure–III) that they have not been re-employed in Government after availing the benefits for ex-servicemen. | Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for each discipline.

qualification.details: The qualification must be from a University/Institute/Examination Board recognised by AICTE, an appropriate statutory authority, or a State or Central Government. Applicants who do not have the prescribed qualification but hold higher qualifications such as B. Tech or M. Sc. shall not be considered. Applicants with an equivalent qualification must submit an Equivalency Certificate issued by the Competent Authority. Without it, the application will not be considered. Applicants must fill in the exact percentage of marks in the online application. Where the board gives grade points and does not define a conversion, the Aggregate Grade Points may be multiplied by 10 to get the percentage.

how_to_apply: Read the User Manual and FAQ published at www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CKSRU, Kolkata) before you start.
Complete the One-time Registration in the SAP Online portal. You can reach the portal through www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CKSRU, Kolkata) from 05 November 2026 to 27 November 2026.
Submit the application against the post. Submit only one application; once submitted, it is final.
Upload certificates in proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste etc. and a recent passport size colour photograph. Applications without these will be rejected.
Pay the application fee of ₹ 400/- online, unless you are SC/ST.
After you submit, log in to My Applications and check that the status shows "In process". Incomplete, withdrawn and draft-status applications are not considered.
Keep a soft copy or printout of the application with the unique registration number, and quote this number in any correspondence with CSL.

Applications sent directly or by any other mode will not be accepted. You do not need to post the printout, certificates or fee (DD/Challan/Cheque) to Cochin Shipyard Ltd/CKSRU. On the last date, no technical support by email or phone may be available after 1600 hrs.

Applicants in regular Government service or in Government-owned organisations should apply online directly. They must upload a declaration (as per Annexure–II) that they have informed their employer in writing. Their candidature will not be considered if the employer raises an objection.

The fee is paid only online (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking etc.) through the online application facility, from 05 November 2026 to 27 November 2026. No other mode of payment is accepted. For applicants who must pay, the application is considered only after the fee is received. Fees are not refunded after submission or withdrawal of an application.

content_sections.heading: About CSL
content_sections.text: Cochin Shipyard Limited describes itself in the notice as a listed premier Miniratna Schedule 'A' Company of the Government of India; its letterhead calls it a Government of India enterprise and a Miniratna company under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways. Both posts in this notification are with its ship repair unit in Kolkata, CSL Kolkata Ship Repair Unit (CKSRU). That unit works on dry docks, berths, ship docking and afloat repairs.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice has 2 vacancies, both in grade PS1 and both unreserved (UR). CSL reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, not to fill the vacancy, or to cancel the recruitment process, as per its requirement. Government of India directives on reservation apply. The posts have not been identified as suitable for PwBDs. The notice gives the reason: the work calls for frequent visits to work sites, shops, docks and ships under construction and repair. It also involves climbing vertical ladders, moving through narrow passages and manholes, and working in confined spaces and at heights.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential experience: Seven years post qualification experience in supervisory capacity or above in works relating to civil, and to construction and maintenance of Infrastructure projects including housekeeping. This experience must be in a Shipyard, an Engineering company, a Large Civil construction company, or a Government / Semi-Government Company / Establishment. Desirable: Ability to speak in Hindi/ Bengali/ English. Knowledge of civil construction and maintenance practices related to marine/industrial infrastructure. Familiarity with dry dock and berth maintenance activities. Ability to supervise manpower and contractors effectively. Understanding of engineering drawings, estimates, and specifications. Good coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills. Awareness of industrial safety procedures and quality practices. Basic computer knowledge for reporting and documentation. Experience: Seven years post qualification experience in mechanical works in a Shipyard, a Dockyard, an Engineering Company or a Government Establishment. Out of the seven years, two years should be in supervising mechanical works and workmen. Desirable: Ability to speak in Hindi/ Bengali/ English. Experience of working in an ERP/ SAP/ computerised environment. The qualification must be from a University/Institute/Examination Board recognised by AICTE, an appropriate statutory authority, or a State or Central Government. Applicants who do not have the prescribed qualification but hold higher qualifications such as B. Tech or M. Sc. shall not be considered. Applicants with an equivalent qualification must submit an Equivalency Certificate issued by the Competent Authority. Without it, the application will not be considered. Applicants must fill in the exact percentage of marks in the online application. Where the board gives grade points and does not define a conversion, the Aggregate Grade Points may be multiplied by 10 to get the percentage. Only experience gained after passing the prescribed qualification counts. Post-qualification experience is reckoned as on 27 November 2026. Completed Apprenticeship Training in the relevant discipline/trade under the Apprentices Act, 1961 counts as experience, and so does any training with remuneration. Training does not count towards the two years of supervisory experience. For short listing, CSL considers only experience certificates from companies registered under the Companies Act, 1956 or foreign companies of equivalent status. Applicants currently employed without an experience certificate should submit their Appointment / Offer letter and latest Pay Slip / copy of last Pay drawn. For past jobs, the experience certificate must show the dates of joining and relieving. Experience with contractors (Proprietary and Partnership Firms) may be considered if the Principal Employer has endorsed the certificate. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts are in grade PS1 with the pay scale ₹ 28,000-3%-1,10,000. The notice gives these monthly emoluments as on date: Other benefits listed in the notice, as admissible under CSL rules: New Pension Scheme, Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, Accident Insurance coverage, Medical Assistance Scheme, Post-Retirement Medical Assistance Scheme, Earned Leave encashment and Performance related Payment. The selected candidate will be placed at the minimum of the pay scale. Pay protection will not be considered. Posting will be at CSL Kolkata Ship Repair Unit (CKSRU) Kolkata or any other CSL units/project sites as desired by CSL. The candidate is liable to be transferred to different units of CSL depending on project requirements. The appointment carries the obligation to serve in any department of CSL, on board ships, or in any unit, work site or project in any part of India or abroad. CSL will not bear any liability for salary, leave salary, gratuity or pension contribution related to a candidate's previous employment in Government or Public Sector Undertakings.

content_sections.heading: CSL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists job requirements for the Assistant Engineer (Civil) post only. Planning, organizing and coordinating civil engineering works for ship repair infrastructure, including dry docks, berths, workshops, buildings, roads, drainage systems and other allied facilities. Execution and timely completion of civil maintenance, construction and infrastructure development works related to ship repair projects. Supervising and monitoring civil works associated with ship docking, afloat repairs, estate management, housekeeping services, staging/scaffolding activities and vessel accommodation works. Coordinating with production, planning, mechanical, electrical and safety departments, clients, vendors and contractors. Supervising contractors and workforce and ensuring optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, equipment and materials. Ensuring civil works follow approved drawings, technical specifications, quality standards, work schedules and statutory requirements. Conducting routine inspections of civil structures and maintaining records of work progress, site activities, measurements and material utilization. Assisting in the preparation of estimates, work orders, technical reports and project documentation. Ensuring strict compliance with Yard Quality Management System, HSE requirements, environmental regulations and safety standards. Participating in emergency repair works, breakdown maintenance and other urgent civil engineering activities as and when required. Being a good team player, being willing to travel at short notice, and working against set targets within the stipulated time frame. Performing any other duties assigned by the competent authority in the interest of the Company.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Read the User Manual and FAQ published at www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CKSRU, Kolkata) before you start. Complete the One-time Registration in the SAP Online portal. You can reach the portal through www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CKSRU, Kolkata) from 05 November 2026 to 27 November 2026. Submit the application against the post. Submit only one application; once submitted, it is final. Upload certificates in proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste etc. and a recent passport size colour photograph. Applications without these will be rejected. Pay the application fee of ₹ 400/- online, unless you are SC/ST. After you submit, log in to My Applications and check that the status shows "In process". Incomplete, withdrawn and draft-status applications are not considered. Keep a soft copy or printout of the application with the unique registration number, and quote this number in any correspondence with CSL. Applications sent directly or by any other mode will not be accepted. You do not need to post the printout, certificates or fee (DD/Challan/Cheque) to Cochin Shipyard Ltd/CKSRU. On the last date, no technical support by email or phone may be available after 1600 hrs. Applicants in regular Government service or in Government-owned organisations should apply online directly. They must upload a declaration (as per Annexure–II) that they have informed their employer in writing. Their candidature will not be considered if the employer raises an objection. The fee is paid only online (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking etc.) through the online application facility, from 05 November 2026 to 27 November 2026. No other mode of payment is accepted. For applicants who must pay, the application is considered only after the fee is received. Fees are not refunded after submission or withdrawal of an application.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection for both posts has these stages: Phase I offline test (Objective Type – 40 Marks and Descriptive Type – 40 Marks), then Certificate Verification, then Phase II PowerPoint presentation on work experience (20 Marks). The process will be conducted at CKSRU, Kolkata, or through interview via electronic media. The objective test lasts 45 minutes. It has Part A (General) and Part B (Discipline related). Each question carries one mark, and there is no negative marking. The descriptive offline test is worth 40 marks and lasts 90 minutes, with discipline related questions. CSL will evaluate the descriptive answer sheets only of candidates who reach the minimum pass mark in the objective test and meet the eligibility requirements. The minimum pass mark for all categories (except PwBD) is 50% of the total marks of each test. The syllabus for both tests is in Annexure I, which the notice says is only indicative and not exhaustive. Tests will be held in West Bengal, as decided by CKSRU, depending on the number of applications. CSL alone decides the allocation of exam centres. Depending on the number of applications, CSL may also shortlist applicants by checking the certificates they uploaded. Qualified candidates are called for certificate verification in order of merit/reservation, at a minimum ratio of 6 candidates per post. Candidates must produce all certificates in original. Only those who clear verification attend Phase II, which may go ahead even with fewer than 1:6 candidates. Phase II is a presentation of not more than ten minutes on the candidate's work experience, worth 20 marks. It will be held at CSL-Kolkata Ship Repair Unit, Kolkata. The rank list is based on the total marks of Phase I and Phase II. Ties are broken first by the discipline marks in the objective test and then by seniority in age. Candidates attending the selection at CKSRU, Kolkata get single to-and-fro third AC rail fare by the shortest route from their mailing address, on proof. To claim it, they must submit a copy of the front page of their savings bank passbook with account number and IFSC code at certificate verification. This does not apply to selection through electronic media, or to candidates found ineligible at verification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Assistant Engineer (Civil) and one Assistant Engineer (Mechanical), both UR, at CSL Kolkata Ship Repair Unit.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the online application is 27 November 2026. Applications open on 05 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the CSL Assistant Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The Civil post needs a three-year Diploma in Civil Engineering, and the Mechanical post needs a three-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering. Both posts also need seven years of post-qualification experience as specified for each post.

faq.question: Q4. Can B.Tech or M.Sc. holders apply?
faq.answer: Not unless they also hold the prescribed diploma. Applicants without the prescribed qualification who have higher qualifications such as B. Tech or M. Sc. shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age shall not exceed 45 years as on 27 November 2026, meaning applicants should be born on or after 28 November 1981. Ex-servicemen get relaxation up to 50 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a CSL Assistant Engineer?
faq.answer: The post is in grade PS1 with the pay scale ₹ 28,000-3%-1,10,000. The monthly emoluments as on date total ₹62,748.00, including DA, HRA and perks.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹ 400/- (non-refundable, plus bank charges), paid online only. SC/ST applicants are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for CSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register and apply in the SAP Online portal through www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CKSRU, Kolkata), and upload your certificates and photograph there. No other mode is accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for CSL Assistant Engineer?
faq.answer: Selection has a Phase I offline test (Objective 40 marks and Descriptive 40 marks), then certificate verification, then a Phase II PowerPoint presentation on work experience (20 marks).

faq.question: Q10. Is there negative marking in the CSL Assistant Engineer test?
faq.answer: No. Each objective question carries one mark, and there are no negative marks. The minimum pass mark is 50% of the total marks of each test (except for PwBD).
